title: Machine Unlearning in Hyperbolic vs. Euclidean Multimodal Contrastive Learning: Adapting Alignment Calibration to MERU
reasoning: The paper investigates machine unlearning techniques for vision-language models like CLIP and MERU. While it mentions ethical and legal concerns as motivation for the field (e.g., removal of harmful content or NSFW data), the core of the paper is a technical comparison of geometric representation spaces (hyperbolic vs. Euclidean) and does not evaluate religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or formal moral/ethical reasoning frameworks.
